Actually, do you have any tips on using keyboard controls for gaming? I'm not used to it.

Sure, here are some general tips for using keyboard controls for gaming:

1. Customize your controls: If the game allows you to customize your controls, then do so. Set the controls to something that feels comfortable for you.

2. Be patient: Using keyboard controls might take some getting used to, so don't get frustrated if you don't get it right away. Give yourself time to practice and adjust.

3. Use the right keys: Make sure you are using the right keys for the action you want to perform. Some games require specific key combinations for certain actions, so be sure to read the instructions carefully.

4. Sit comfortably: Make sure you are sitting in a comfortable position, and that your keyboard is at the right height and angle for you.

5. Practice, practice, practice: The more you use keyboard controls, the more comfortable you will become with them. Play games that require different types of keyboard inputs to help you become more familiar with the keys.
